properties/action: List/search available skills, load instructions, or unload active skills.
properties/selector: Exact metadata name or package/SKILL.md path; optional for unload-all.
properties/arguments: Argument text for the skill's declared placeholders; quote multi-word arguments.
properties/query: Case-insensitive substring of a skill name or description when listing.
properties/limit: Maximum number of entries to return, from 1 to 50.
